SDSS-V also observes from Las Campanas Observatory, Chile; that facility is not in this stream and is listed for the integrator.

summary.plain: The international collaboration that runs the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, whose successive phases mapped the sky and, with BOSS and eBOSS, measured how fast the universe expands.
summary.technical: SDSS Collaboration: hundreds of scientists at numerous institutions; operates SDSS-V (since October 2020) at Apache Point and Las Campanas, managed by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
